items.title: Logo lacks punch on dark background
items.what: The blue 'S' logo on the loading screen has low contrast against the black background, appearing dim and losing edge definition due to soft lighting or compression.
items.why: First impression is weakened; players may not immediately recognize the brand or feel the game’s energy.
items.how: Add a subtle white or gold outline (1-2px) to the logo or increase its brightness/contrast in the texture to make it pop without breaking the warm aesthetic.

items.title: Score text blends into warm HUD
items.what: The '30' center score on the HUD uses a gold/yellow color that is too close to the warm background, reducing readability at a glance.
items.why: Players need to see the score instantly during fast-paced bouts; low contrast slows recognition.
items.how: Change the score color to a high-contrast white with a thin black stroke or dark outline to ensure visibility against the warm HUD.

items.title: Fighters appear to float above the floor
items.what: The sprite fighters cast no visible shadows on the tatami, making them look disconnected from the 3D floor.
items.why: Breaks immersion and weakens the sense of physical presence in the dojo, a core part of the game’s cinematic feel.
items.how: Add a subtle, semi-transparent drop shadow beneath each fighter sprite, matched to the floor’s lighting angle and color temperature.

items.title: Rematch button has excessive bloom glare
items.what: The 'REMATCH' button’s gold bloom effect is so strong that it washes out the button’s text and edges, making it hard to read.
items.why: Players may hesitate or mis-tap due to unclear affordance, hurting replayability flow.
items.how: Reduce the bloom intensity on the button by 50% and add a subtle inner shadow to the text to improve legibility.

items.title: Settings toggles are hard to see as interactive
items.what: The checkboxes in the Settings menu use a dark gray that blends into the black background, making it unclear they are tappable.
items.why: Players may miss accessibility options or struggle to change settings, impacting usability.
items.how: Increase the toggle contrast with a white or light gray outline and add a subtle glow or highlight on the active state.
